CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE
CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY

Commit and deploy only the existing VERIFYING-timeout fix.

After deployment, return:

- full GitHub commit SHA
- Render deployment ID
- final Render status
- runtime SHA
- /health HTTP result
- /version result
- timeout value configured
- test proving a hung verification moves to TIMED_OUT
- retry/recovery result
- confirmation that no unrelated files changed

Do not report complete until GitHub HEAD equals Render runtime SHA and the live timeout test passes.
